title: US and Japan jointly intervene to prop up yen in rare move
summary: The US and Japan conducted a coordinated intervention to support the yen, marking a rare joint action and signaling willingness to repeat such moves in the future. This reflects shared concerns about currency stability and its broader economic implications.
content: Both countries have said that they will not hesitate to conduct joint interventions in the future.

zh.title: 美国和日本罕见联合干预支撑日元
zh.summary: 美国和日本进行了协调干预以支持日元，标志着罕见的联合行动，并表明未来愿意重复此类举措。这反映了双方对货币稳定性及其更广泛经济影响的共同关切。

title: Oil drops over 4% as Middle East tensions ebb on diplomatic efforts
summary: Oil prices fell over 4% as geopolitical risk premiums declined following President Trump's announcement that he had called off a planned strike on Iran. The reduction in military tensions eased investor concerns about Middle East supply disruptions.
content: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors pared geopolitical risk premiums after U.S. President Donald Trump said he had called off a planned strike on Iran.

zh.title: 中东局势缓解，油价下跌超过4%
zh.summary: 在特朗普总统宣布取消计划对伊朗进行的打击后，地缘政治风险溢价下降，油价下跌超过4%。军事紧张局势的缓解缓解了投资者对中东供应中断的担忧。

title: Stock futures rally as investors gear up for jobs report, key earnings: Live updates
summary: Financial markets are preparing for the July jobs report and a batch of major earnings releases in early August, which are critical indicators for assessing economic health and corporate performance. These data points could significantly influence market direction in coming weeks.
content: The first week of August kicks off with the July jobs report and another batch of key earnings reports.

zh.title: 股指期货上涨，投资者为就业报告和主要财报做准备
zh.summary: 金融市场正在为7月就业报告和8月初的一批主要财报做准备，这些是评估经济健康状况和企业业绩的关键指标。这些数据点可能会在未来几周对市场方向产生重大影响。

title: New Spider-Man film sees second-biggest ever global opening weekend
summary: The latest Spider-Man film achieved the second-largest opening weekend in global box office history, providing Disney with crucial momentum ahead of the Avengers: Doomsday release. The strong performance demonstrates sustained audience interest in superhero franchises.
content: The film's strong performance gives a much-needed boost for Disney ahead of the highly-anticipated release of Avengers: Doomsday.

zh.title: 新蜘蛛侠电影创全球历史第二大开场周末票房
zh.summary: 最新的蜘蛛侠电影在全球票房历史上创造了第二大开场周末，为迪士尼在《复仇者联盟：末日之战》上映前积累了关键动力。这一强劲表现证明了观众对超级英雄特许经营权的持续兴趣。

title: Trump says Iran talks to resume Monday after calling off planned strikes
summary: Following Trump's decision to cancel planned strikes on Iran, diplomatic negotiations are resuming with a new proposal for warring parties to return to talks. The fresh initiative aims to resolve key issues that previously derailed peace efforts.
content: The latest peace proposal calls for warring parties to return to negotiations and continue working out some of the thorny issues that derailed diplomatic efforts.

zh.title: 特朗普在取消计划打击伊朗后称伊朗谈判将于周一恢复
zh.summary: 在特朗普取消对伊朗的计划打击后，外交谈判以新提议恢复，敦促交战各方回到谈判桌前。这一新举措旨在解决之前阻碍和平努力的关键问题。

title: Almost £200,000 of fuel stolen from UK forecourts every day since Iran war began
summary: Fuel theft from UK gas stations has surged by 20% in five months, with thieves taking nearly £200,000 worth of fuel daily since Middle East tensions escalated. The spike reflects growing economic pressures on consumers and mounting security challenges for fuel retailers.
content: Incidents of fuel being taken without payment have risen by a fifth in five months, according to industry analysis.

zh.title: 自伊朗战争开始以来英国加油站每天被盗燃料近20万英镑
zh.summary: 过去五个月内，英国加油站燃料被盗事件激增20%，自中东局势升级以来，小偷每天盗取近20万英镑的燃料。这一激增反映了消费者日益增长的经济压力和燃料零售商面临的日益增加的安全挑战。

title: U.S., Japan confirm coordinated yen intervention, signal readiness for more
summary: Japan's finance ministry confirmed a coordinated yen-buying intervention with the US Treasury on Friday, with both nations signaling readiness for future coordinated action. The joint effort reflects shared concerns about currency stability and its economic consequences.
content: Japan's finance ministry said Monday it conducted a coordinated yen-buying intervention with the U.S. Treasury on Friday.

zh.title: 美国和日本确认协调日元干预，表示准备采取进一步行动
zh.summary: 日本财务省周五确认了与美国财政部的协调日元买入干预，两国都表示为未来的协调行动做好准备。这一联合努力反映了对货币稳定性及其经济后果的共同关切。
